source.quote: Let δ ∈ (0, 1) and βt = 2 log(|D|t^2π^2/6δ). Running GP-UCB with βt for a sample f of a GP with mean function zero and covariance function k(x, x'), we obtain a regret bound of O*(sqrt(T γT log |D|)) with high probability. Precisely, Pr{RT ≤ sqrt(C1 T βT γT) ∀T ≥ 1} ≥ 1 − δ. where C1 = 8/log(1 + σ^{-2}).

results.notes: Regret is f(x*)-f(x_t) summed. K = |D|. The sqrt covers C1 T beta_T gamma_T (confirmed by proof).

source.quote: Let D ⊂ [0, r]^d be compact and convex ... Pick δ ∈ (0, 1), and define βt = 2 log(t^2 2π^2/(3δ)) + 2d log(t^2 d b r sqrt(log(4da/δ))). Running the GP-UCB with βt ... we obtain a regret bound of O*(sqrt(dT γT)) with high probability. Precisely, with C1 = 8/log(1 + σ^{-2}) we have Pr{RT ≤ sqrt(C1 T βT γT) + 2 ∀T ≥ 1} ≥ 1 − δ.

results.notes: Maximizing the UCB on infinite D may be hard, so compute not_stated. Combined with Theorem 5, gives O*(sqrt(T (log T)^{d+1})) for SE kernel and O*(T^{(nu+d(d+1))/(2nu+d(d+1))}) for Matern (nu>2), but those are stated informally.

In particular, assume ||f||_k^2 ≤ B and let βt = 2B + 300γt log^3(t/δ). ... Pr{RT ≤ sqrt(C1 T βT γT) ∀T ≥ 1} ≥ 1 − δ, where C1 = 8/log(1 + σ^{-2}).
